scope: M1 follow-up development study, fixed before new head training; no actor or joint SFT update
groups: Fused image-position states versus fused prompt-position states; prompt includes instruction, q and formatting, not isolated language semantics
historical_reference: global_mean width=2048 hidden=128 parameters=266497; retained, not overwritten
primary_comparison: vision_prompt_concat minus global_duplicate MAE within each instruction condition, paired by validation episode and head seed
secondary_comparison: instruction minus no_instruction, separately for each readout; MSE, per-task errors and advantage labels also reported
checkpoint_rule: Fixed final step 500; no validation-selected checkpoint
sampling: Same task/episode/decision probabilities and seed-matched sample sequence as M1
limits: Development selection only; readout changes do not establish VLM forgetting, instruction grounding or policy improvement
